australian_revenue_share.label: Australia
australian_revenue_share.note: Note 4(A) (printed p.77): net passenger and freight revenue Australia 14,924 of total 20,114; other revenue and income 1,825 not allocated; total revenue and other income 21,939. Attributed by point of sale.

checks.income_statement_identity: 21,939 (revenue and other income) - 19,854 (sum of listed expense lines incl. (4) equity-accounted profit and (18) net gain on disposal) + 117 (finance income) - 318 (finance costs) = 1,884 vs printed PBT 1,884.

issues: Single 'Revenue and other income' total; other income not separable from other revenue.
Expenses by nature; no cost of sales or materials line. 'Fuel' used as nearest consumables line (classification choice).
AASB 16 in force: right of use assets (1,315) outside PP&E; lease costs split between depreciation and finance costs, so not comparable with FY2005/FY2015 operating-lease rental lines.
No employee count in the Annual Report.
